title: 16-year-old turned a childhood art project into a lifeline for children in hospitals
summary_full: Dani McTague, who started 'Dani's Dream' at ten, has donated over 3,700 art bags to children in need. Her initiative grew after receiving nationwide donations during the COVID-19 pandemic. McTague has also served as a 4-H Ambassador and led numerous workshops to mentor younger leaders. Recently selected for the Hall of Fame, she received a scholarship for her achievements.
